data:
Decision: NO-GO. Win probability: 1.9%.

Top factors driving probability (from SHAP impacts):
1) Low expected evaluation score (est. 68.7) is the dominant negative driver (largest downward impact), suggesting we will not be competitive on technical/quality scoring.
2) Limited response time (240 hrs) further reduces likelihood; insufficient runway to materially improve solution, staffing, and documentation quality.
3) Minor positives (short tender: 3 pages; only 1 compliance gap) are too small to offset the expected scoring weakness.

Mandatory gaps and what closing them takes:
- Gap: Team must include at least two certified data security professionals (CISSP or equivalent). To close: confirm availability, secure commitments/LOIs, validate “equivalent” certifications acceptance, update CVs, and align roles/responsibilities in the proposal; may require subcontracting or hiring.

Recommendation: Do not bid unless we can immediately lock two CISSPs and uplift the technical approach to materially exceed the current estimated score.
